_sheet: Card picker UI (uGUI, built at runtime, no asset bundle). One row = one UI element. Generated/UiLayout.cs gets a static class per row with its Size, Text template and every entry of consts (numbers become float consts, 4-number arrays become Colors, strings become string consts). Fonts: the game's own TMP font found at runtime; card colours come from cards.json themes and the art from art.json.

_columns.visual: what it looks like, in words
_columns.consts: named numbers / colours / strings the code needs for this element

canvas.fontNote: every mod text uses this font (assets/fonts, shipped next to the DLL; SIL Open Font License); the game's own font is its fallback, and the whole UI falls back to it when the file is missing or UI.CustomFont is off. Darumadrop One has one heavy weight: bold is synthesised, so fontBoldStyle and fontBoldSpacing keep TMP's faux bold light (TMP defaults 0.75 and 7 clog its counters at small sizes). Line heights in rows are multiples of the font size; the code converts them for whichever font is in use
canvas.scaleNote: CanvasScaler ScaleWithScreenSize, match 0.5. Config General.UiScale multiplies it (0 = auto: 1, or smallScreenScale on screens at most smallScreenHeight pixels tall, such as a Steam Deck). Layouts that could outgrow the screen (card fan, Current Build) measure the canvas and keep safeMargin from every edge

palette._note: Colour roles for every mod overlay: campfire at night. Panels are warm near-black (the cards' world), secondary text is warm grey derived from them, gold is the campfire accent. Row consts refer to a role as "@name". Contrast (worst case: panel over snow): text, textSoft, muted, good, accent, callout pass 4.5:1 on every surface; faint and bad pass only on surfaceStrong and on card faces, so use them nowhere else. Green/red never carry meaning alone: card lines and Current Build stats carry + / - markers.

rows.visual: MenuWindow subclass (blocksPlayerInput, showCursorWhileOpen) with a dark backdrop
rows.behaviour: Open() when it is the local player's turn; Close() after a pick or timeout; the game blocks movement and shows the cursor through MenuWindow. With a controller the first card is selected on open and the D-pad or stick moves between cards (explicit grid navigation), confirm takes the selected card. Reveal and sample fans also close on a click on the backdrop or on cancel.

rows.visual: TMP bold uppercase white on a soft dark band
rows.behaviour: reasonTitle depends on the session reason (SacrificeTitle names the card that asks for it); narrowed to the canvas less safeMargin and shrunk (to MinFontSize) when the screen is narrow

rows.behaviour: With a positive host timeout, counts down (Text, SacrificeTemplate) and the host takes a random card at 0; with timeoutSeconds = 0 there is no countdown or automatic pick (UntimedText, SacrificeUntimedText). After a click it shows PendingTemplate until the host confirms; with no answer after pickPendingRetrySeconds the cards can be chosen again (RetryTemplate, RetryUntimedText)

rows.behaviour: layers animate on unscaled time so they keep moving while the game pauses

rows.anchor: top, y=-184: 10 below the art, tucked up against the name it labels

uppercase white, up to two lines at full size (shrinks only below that, to MinFontSize), top-aligned
